summary: August ADP private payrolls came in at just 38,000, well below forecasts, setting a soft tone ahead of Friday's official BLS report and reinforcing expectations that central banks must maintain tight monetary policies as energy market shocks push Brent crude past $92.
tweet: Soft ADP print (38K vs 48K est.) and $92 oil are pulling markets in opposite directions ahead of Friday's jobs report, with a Fed hike now near coin-flip odds.
